integrity: The accepted counts are regenerated from the deletion definition by the embedded dependency-free verifier. The maximal-clique search is exhaustive, with no timeout, random sampling, or cached enumeration.
limitations: Finite exact classification only for binary length six with one deletion. The optimum size \(10\) is prior work. The orbit statement is restricted to reversal and global complement and does not claim the full isometry group. An obscure unindexed prior census remains a residual originality risk.
title: Complete census of maximum binary length-six single-deletion codes
